newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler - restructure to cut central admin costs.
newsitem.headline: Daimler - restructure to cut central admin costs.

text.p: A restructuring plan approved by the supervisory board of Daimler-Benz AG will cut central administrative costs by about 30 percent, a Daimler spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
The spokesman declined to say specifically how much would be saved.

Daimler announced earlier on Thursday that its supervisory board formally approved plans to merge Mercedes-Benz AG into the group's management structure and would trim management overhead at it two other main units, Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG (DASA) and Debis AG.
